data.name: Comet Dudes
data.detailed_description:
Colorful ships. Questionable teamwork. Too many asteroids.

Comet Dudes is a colorful arcade space shooter built for solo play, local multiplayer, and true online co-op. Fly through increasingly chaotic waves, dodge tumbling asteroids and incoming plasma, battle alien probes and gunships, and work together to bring down powerful bosses.

Or try to do all of that while your friends are being painfully “helpful.”

FLY, FIGHT, AND WRAP AROUND

Take control of your ship in a 2D zero-G arena where momentum matters and danger can come from any direction. Maneuver through asteroid fields, outrun torpedoes, dodge enemy fire, and use the screen-wrapping arena to escape trouble—or find yourself flying straight back into it.

Fire your plasma cannons to break apart asteroids and fight increasingly dangerous aliens. The longer you survive, the more crowded, unpredictable, and rewarding the arena becomes.

BUILD YOUR PERFECT LOADOUT

Unlock and equip abilities that can completely change how you approach a fight:

• Hunt enemies with seeker missiles
• Absorb incoming damage with shields
• Gain greater control with flight assist
• Repair your ship using nanites
• Turn parts of the arena into a minefield
• Escape danger with phase shift

During each match, destroyed enemies can drop upgrades for your cannon, equipment, and health, along with temporary powerups that might give you the edge you need to survive the next wave.

Want more engine thrust? More health? Or an extremely powerful ship that falls apart when an asteroid looks at it too aggressively? Unlock three tiers of system routing and move points away from systems you don’t need to strengthen the ones that fit your playstyle.

MAKE YOUR SHIP YOURS

Choose your colors across three customizable sections—Hull, Accents, and Effects—to create a ship that stands out from the rest of the team.

Destroy asteroids and survive higher waves for a chance to discover relics containing procedurally generated ship parts. Collect components from four different ship packs, then mix and match Hull, Accent, and System parts to build your own distinctive design.

The farther you make it, the rarer and more unusual the relics can become.

QUESTIONABLE TEAMWORK ENCOURAGED

Chase a new high score alone, bring friends together locally, or join them through true online multiplayer. Coordinate abilities, cover one another, and combine your firepower against overwhelming waves and enormous bosses.

You can also scatter in four different directions and hope everything somehow works out.

Complete achievements to unlock new abilities, hunt for rare ship parts, experiment with different system builds, or jump in for a quick round of colorful space chaos.

FEATURES

• Solo, local multiplayer, and true online co-op
• Classic screen-wrapping arcade action
• Asteroids, alien probes, gunships, torpedoes, and boss battles
• Unlockable abilities and three-tier system routing
• In-match upgrades and temporary powerups
• Procedurally generated arenas and modular ship parts
• Extensive ship colors and visual customization
• Full controller support
• Free to play

Inspired by the screen-wrapping arcade action of Comet Busters, reimagined with online multiplayer, modular ships, expanded progression, and a clean, colorful style.

From the creator of Gravity Assist: Initiative.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit, version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 1030 2 GB or AMD Radeon RX 550 2 GB, or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
